claims.statement: For the single fixed uniform LG-POLYARITY131-K8-TAGBANK physical algorithm supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (finite tester when ell=ceil(log2 n)<2^20; otherwise h=ceil(ell/8), f=2^h, q=f, w=min{u:f²u²>=2nh}, y=ceil(n/((f-h)w))+1, the uniform variable-height MERGEG with explicit f-dependent Cap/D and full-b-bit root flags/filter, exact caps, both full-modulus decoders and counted bit-code compiler), for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), unconditional whole-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(2^((501/1000)*sqrt(n*log2 n))), ordinary classical space O(n), full allocated quantum space O(2^((501/1000)*n^(3/8)*sqrt(log2 n))), and total acquired copies O(2^((251/1000)*sqrt(n*log2 n))). Every failure, discard, partial attempt, source guard, retry, abort, initialization, finite exact epoch repair, source move, full address debit and cleanup is charged with absolute constants and the exact displayed exponent coefficients. The corresponding upper envelope has exact index1/2.
